title: Low Vibration Closed-Cycle Flow Cryostat for Ion-Cavity Experiments
abstract: Cryogenic operation below 10 K suppresses trap-electrode and dielectric heating of trapped ions while cryopumping residual gases to ultra-high vacuum (UHV) without requiring a bakeout. These advantages are particularly important for cavity-integrated ion traps, where nearby dielectric surfaces can increase motional heating and rapid design-build-test iterations benefit from eliminating bakeout cycles. We have developed a custom 4 K cryostat cooled by a ColdEdge Technologies (CET) Stinger closed-cycle $^{4}\text{He}$ flow cryogenic system to study various ion trap optical cavity structures designed to serve as a photonic interconnect between remote, compute-capable trapped $^{171}\text{Yb}^{+}$ ion quantum processors, enabling long baseline entanglement distribution $(>10\text{ km})$. We integrate an Alpine Quantum Technologies (AQT) Paul trap and Fabry-Pérot optical cavity at the 4 K stage. The cooling capacities of the cryostat 40 K and 4 K stages were measured to be 5 W at 45 K and 0.5 W at 6.1 K. Vibrations of the 4 K stage relative to the optical table are less than $12\text{ nm}_{\text{RMS}}$ in three dimensions, as measured using a Michelson interferometer. An ultra-high vacuum (UHV) is inferred by studying the rate of hydrogen-$\mathrm{Yb}^{+}$ ion collisions. Ion storage times exceeding 5 days without laser cooling have been reported and the position of the trapped ions are reproducible within $\sim10\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ following repeated thermal cycles to room temperature. The uptime of this system is 72 days and offers convenient access to the 4 K stage for in-vacuum maintenance and system modifications. Using this platform, we demonstrate spatial overlap and interaction between a trapped $^{174}\text{Yb}^{+}$ ion and the optical cavity mode on the 1345 nm transition, establishing preliminary experimental validation of the integrated cryogenic ion-cavity structure.

summaries.en: A custom 4 K closed-cycle helium flow cryostat integrating a Paul trap and Fabry-Pérot cavity achieves sub-12 nm RMS vibrations, UHV-compatible ion storage exceeding 5 days, and demonstrates spatial overlap and interaction between a trapped 174Yb+ ion and the 1345 nm cavity mode.

title: Pseudo-Altermagnetism in Non-Hermitian Systems
abstract: Altermagnetism has attracted growing attention, and its analogs have been actively explored across classical platforms. Here, we introduce pseudo-altermagnetism in non-Hermitian systems, where balanced gain and loss plays the role of the altermagnetic spin, and the opposite gain and loss sublattices are related by an antiunitary symmetry $O$ with $O\bm k\neq \bm k$ for generic momentum $\bm k$. Using a two-dimensional non-Hermitian system with $O=C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ symmetry as a representative example, we find that pseudo-altermagnetism not only leads to a momentum-dependent gain and loss distribution analogous to the momentum-dependent spin splitting of altermagnets, but also exhibits intrinsic non-Hermitian properties. The bands of $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$-invariant non-Hermitian systems are either isolated or paired by $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$, and both cases are guaranteed to host movable but unremovable nodal structures, characterized by the zeros of two distinct quantities. An isolated band exhibits two movable but unremovable Hermitian spectral lines, whose generic points are not invariant under $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$, in sharp contrast to the conventional Hermitian spectra enforced only at the fixed points of an antiunitary symmetry. The paired bands, in turn, feature a movable but unremovable nodal network formed by the union of real-part and imaginary-part degeneracy lines, whose intersections are generally exceptional points. We further demonstrate these findings in a non-Hermitian photonic crystal. Our results establish a symmetry-based bridge between non-Hermitian physics and altermagnetism, and provide novel mechanisms of Hermitian spectra beyond $\mathcal{PT}$ symmetry.

summaries.en: This paper introduces pseudo-altermagnetism in non-Hermitian systems, where balanced gain and loss plays the role of altermagnetic spin and opposite gain/loss sublattices are related by an antiunitary symmetry O with O k ≠ k, yielding momentum-dependent gain/loss distributions, movable but unremovable nodal structures, Hermitian spectral lines, and nodal networks with exceptional points, as demonstrated in a non-Hermitian photonic crystal.

title: Designing Incoherent Multispectral Diffractive Optical Networks for Satellite Image Classification
abstract: Optical neural networks and diffractive optical computing provide a promising route for performing task-specific inference with high parallelism and lightweight electronic post-processing. These advantages are especially attractive for multispectral satellite imaging, where conventional workflows rely on transmitting high-dimensional image cubes to the ground for downstream electronic analysis. Here, we introduce a computationally efficient surrogate model-guided framework for designing incoherent multispectral diffractive optical networks that directly output class probabilities onboard, eliminating the need to capture and transfer the full multispectral data cube for ground-side inference. We first train a physically compatible surrogate model, represented by a non-negative fully connected model that accommodates a generalized detector readout, yielding a task-specific non-negative multispectral intensity transformation that can be transferred to an optical processor. We then synthesize its diffractive counterpart through data-free point-spread-function-based optimization under spatially incoherent illumination. Using this approach, we numerically demonstrate a six-spectral-channel diffractive classifier for tri-class satellite-scene recognition, achieving a blind-testing accuracy of 79.8% for artificial surface, water body, and vegetated land images, closely approaching the 81.8% accuracy of its surrogate. We further demonstrate a more compact three-spectral-channel design that numerically achieves 72.7% blind-testing accuracy, compared with 75.1% for its corresponding surrogate model. This surrogate model-guided strategy provides a practical pathway for designing compact, task-specific incoherent multispectral optical processors for resource-constrained remote-sensing inference.

title: Relativistic Harmonic Generation in Spatiotemporal Plasma Photonic Crystals
abstract: Spatiotemporal photonic crystals offer a route to controlling the frequency, momentum, and energy of light. Extending this capability to relativistic laser intensities calls for a plasma-based platform. Here we propose a spatiotemporal plasma photonic crystal (SPPC) formed at a solid surface driven by intense pump pulses, with a separate probe interacting with the resulting modulation. The spatial and temporal periodicity of the SPPC determines the allowed harmonic frequencies and emission angles, while its complex Floquet bands explain how the probe draws energy from the modulation. Beyond harmonic generation, this picture predicts wavelength-dependent probe amplification as the probe accesses amplifying modes of the SPPC, providing an experimentally testable connection between the band structure and energy transfer. Agreement with particle-in-cell simulations supports this interpretation.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a spatiotemporal plasma photonic crystal formed on a solid surface by intense pump pulses, where spatial and temporal periodicity sets the allowed harmonic frequencies and emission angles, and Floquet band structure explains probe energy gain, including wavelength-dependent amplification confirmed by particle-in-cell simulations.

title: Strain-driven terahertz phase modulation in piezoelectric and nonlinear optical crystals: mechanisms, material developments, and modulation strategies
abstract: Terahertz (THz) technology has witnessed notable developments in sensing, spectroscopy, imaging, and wireless communication which have increased the demand for high-performance THz modulators. Among the various approaches for controlling the THz waves, the application of external stimuli such as optical pumping and thermal or electric fields is widely employed as a promising strategy for modulation. This review focuses on recent advances in THz modulation based on different materials including 2D semiconductors and metamaterials with attention to their response under external stimuli. In addition, strain-driven THz modulation in non-centrosymmetric piezoelectric materials including organic and semi-organic crystals is examined with an emphasis on their ability to establish strong coupling between propagating THz waves and lattice vibrations under piezoelectric resonance conditions. We further highlight earlier reports on strain-driven THz modulation in lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and critically assess the potential of several other nonlinear optical crystals exhibiting piezoelectric resonance peaks suitable for strain-driven THz modulation. An overview of THz modulators integrated with tunable materials is presented highlighting their operating principles and key performance metrics comprising modulation speed, bandwidth, modulation depth and insertion loss.

summaries.en: This review examines recent advances in terahertz modulation using materials such as 2D semiconductors and metamaterials, with a focus on strain-driven phase modulation in non-centrosymmetric piezoelectric and nonlinear optical crystals (including LiNbO3) where piezoelectric resonance enables strong coupling between propagating terahertz waves and lattice vibrations.
summaries.zh: 本综述考察了利用二维半导体和超材料等材料进行太赫兹调制的最新进展，重点介绍了非中心对称压电晶体与非线性光学晶体（包括LiNbO3）中的应变驱动相位调制，其中压电共振可实现传播太赫兹波与晶格振动之间的强耦合。

title: Polarization switching of double azimuthal backflow in two transverse orbital angular momentum superpositions
abstract: Optical backflow in the azimuthal direction can be generated by the interference of two rotating-wave structured light beams with distinct transverse topological charges and equal intensity. Here we show that the interference reverses both azimuthal components of the Poynting and the canonical momenta. Although these two momenta are not generally tied, they reverse jointly here: both acquire azimuthal backflow in a common angular sector, while their radial intervals can differ. The double backflow is switched solely by the polarizations of the two beams, without amplitude tuning. A single polarization overlap enters the interference terms of both momenta but not the single-beam terms of either, so that matched polarizations switch the double backflow on whereas mismatched ones switch it off. The double backflow is periodic in the azimuthal direction, with its angular period locked to the topological charge difference and independent of the individual charges. Our results establish a vectorial mechanism for polarization-gated azimuthal backflow, with potential applications in polarization-switchable optical manipulation.

summaries.en: Interference of two equal-intensity rotating-wave structured light beams with different transverse topological charges reverses both the azimuthal Poynting and canonical momentum components jointly over a common angular sector, producing a double azimuthal backflow that is switched on or off solely by matching or mismatching the beam polarizations and whose angular period is set by the topological charge difference.
summaries.zh: 两束具有不同横向拓扑电荷且等强度的旋转波结构光的干涉会共同反转坡印廷动量与正则动量的方位角分量，在一个共同角扇区内产生双重方位角回流，该回流仅由两束光的偏振匹配与否来开启或关闭，其角周期由拓扑电荷差决定。
summaries.ja: 異なる横方向トポロジカル電荷を持つ等強度の回転波構造光2光束の干渉により、ポインティング運動量と正準運動量の方位角成分が共通の角度セクター内で同時に反転して二重の方位角バックフローが生じ、これはビームの偏光の一致・不一致のみでオン・オフが切り替わり、その角度周期はトポロジカル電荷の差で決まる。

title: Computation in flight through precision-processed optical fiber
abstract: In distributed sensing and computing systems, optoelectronic conversion, buffering, and scheduling can make data movement a bottleneck. We propose FBG-CA, a passive computing module fabricated by automated through-coating inscription of weak fiber Bragg gratings (FBGs). The spatially distributed FBGs reflect, delay, and accumulate temporal samples to produce a convolution output in the backward direction, while the forward signal carries the original data stream to a remote receiver. This enables transmission and convolution within the same optical propagation event. To mitigate finite reflectivity resolution and fabrication deviations, we combine quantization-aware training with sharpness-aware minimization. Over 1440 m of computing fiber, the single-wavelength implementation achieves a convolution correlation coefficient of 0.987, classification accuracies of 87.90% on MNIST and 79.07% on MIT-BIH Arrhythmia, and an estimated throughput of 288 GOPS. With approximately 20% forward-power reduction (0.97 dB) across the FBG sections, the recovered MNIST images achieve a mean structural similarity index of 0.9930, and the recovered MIT-BIH heartbeat waveforms have a mean squared error of 0.005826. Using four wavelength-division-multiplexed channels over 144 m of computing fiber, FBG-CA achieves 92.25% accuracy on four-class Fashion-MNIST and an estimated throughput of 115.2 GOPS. An architecture-level projection indicates an intrinsic throughput density of 1.6 POPS/m for eight wavelengths at 100 GBaud per wavelength. These results demonstrate passive, wavelength-scalable computation-in-flight in optical fiber.

summaries.en: FBG-CA is a passive fiber-Bragg-grating computing module that performs convolution on optical signals in flight, achieving a correlation coefficient of 0.
summaries.zh: FBG-CA是一种无源光纤布拉格光栅计算模块，可在光信号传输过程中进行卷积运算，在1440米光纤上实现0.
summaries.ja: FBG-CAは光ファイバー伝搬中に畳み込み演算を行うパッシブなファイバーブラッググレーティング計算モジュールであり、1440mのファイバー上で0.

title: SPECTRA-RCWA: A Spectral Propagation Engine for Coupled-Wave Theory with Recursive Admittance
abstract: Rigorous coupled-wave analysis (RCWA) is the standard full-wave solver for periodic metasurfaces, but every solve diagonalises a dense nonsymmetric matrix for each layer. Inverse design repeats this step for every wavelength, angle and polarisation of an objective. On a graphics processor it is the slow step, and its derivative fails where eigenvalues coincide or a diffraction order reaches cutoff. Here we introduce SPECTRA-RCWA, an RCWA forward and adjoint solver that never diagonalises the layer matrix. Each layer step uses three entire functions of the half-size layer matrix, evaluated by matrix products alone, and an admittance recursion, or scattering-matrix doubling for thick layers, keeps the evanescent orders stable. One adjoint field gives the gradient for every design value without a computational graph, and all solves of an objective run as one batch. For 144 solves with 578 x 578 layer matrices, the value and the gradient take 0.25 s on one graphics card, 218 times less than with a differentiable eigendecomposition code. The truncated-series solver TorchRDIT loses accuracy beyond a few tenths of a micrometre unless the user slices the layer; SPECTRA-RCWA keeps single-precision accuracy in layers several wavelengths thick with no setting changed and is 47 to 65 times faster at matched accuracy. Its single-precision gradient stays within 4e-5 of a double-precision reference at a cutoff, where eigendecomposition gradients are wrong by order one. A freeform metagrating designed in 3.4 min on a desktop processor deflects both polarisations by 65 degrees with a band-averaged efficiency of 75%.

summaries.en: SPECTRA-RCWA is a rigorous coupled-wave analysis forward and adjoint solver that avoids per-layer eigendecomposition by evaluating three entire functions of the half-size layer matrix through matrix products and an admittance recursion, yielding fast, stable, single-precision gradient computations for metasurface inverse design.
summaries.zh: SPECTRA-RCWA 是一种严格耦合波分析的正向与伴随求解器，它通过矩阵乘法和导纳递推计算半尺寸层矩阵的三个整函数，从而避免逐层特征分解，为超表面逆向设计提供快速、稳定且单精度的梯度计算。
summaries.ja: SPECTRA-RCWAは、半サイズ層行列の3つの整関数を行列積とアドミタンス再帰で評価することで層ごとの固有値分解を回避する厳密結合波解析の順方向・随伴ソルバであり、メタサーフェスの逆設計に対して高速で安定した単精度勾配計算を実現する。

title: Dark and bright solitons in a multimodal lithium tantalate microresonator
abstract: Bright-soliton and dark-pulse microcombs provide complementary outputs. Integrating both states in a single resonator would expand the operating capabilities of an integrated coherent source, but requires opposite group-velocity-dispersion (GVD) channels while reconciling localized interfamily interaction for dark-pulse formation with spectral isolation for independent bright-soliton pumping. Wavelength-addressed access to both states is achieved in a LiTaO$_3$ microring through two TE-like transverse mode families. The higher-order TE$_{10}$ family fulfills two distinct roles in different spectral regions. Within localized avoided-mode-crossing regions, mode-resolved spectroscopy implicates TE$_{10}$ in perturbing the normal-GVD TE$_{00}$ resonance sequence. Away from these regions, TE$_{10}$ retains anomalous GVD and remains spectrally isolated as an independently pumpable bright-soliton channel; at representative pump resonances, the closest resonance of the non-addressed family is separated by 75--192 loaded cavity linewidths. With the input polarization held fixed, pumping TE$_{00}$ and TE$_{10}$ resonances generates dark-pulse and bright-soliton microcombs, respectively. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first experimental realization of a dark-pulse microcomb in an integrated LiTaO$_3$ microring. These results establish transverse-mode-family engineering as a route to combining localized modal interaction with independent spectral addressing in a single microresonator.

summaries.en: Wavelength-addressed excitation of two TE-like transverse mode families in a single LiTaO3 microring enables dark-pulse and bright-soliton microcombs from the same resonator, marking the first experimental dark-pulse microcomb in an integrated LiTaO3 microring.
summaries.zh: 在单一LiTaO3微环中，通过波长寻址激发两个类TE横模模式族，可在同一谐振腔内分别产生暗脉冲与亮孤子微梳，这是集成LiTaO3微环中暗脉冲微梳的首次实验实现。
summaries.ja: 単一のLiTaO3マイクロリングにおいて2つのTE様横モードファミリーを波長選択的に励起することで、同一共振器から暗パルス及び亮ソリトンマイクロコムを生成し、集積LiTaO3マイクロリングにおける暗パルスマイクロコムの初の実験的実現を達成した。

title: Confidence-Aware Discriminative Readout of Neutral-Atom Arrays
abstract: Fast and reliable detection is a central requirement for neutral atom quantum computers, yet fluorescence imaging remains a limiting step for rapid experimental cycling, large-scale array operation, and quantum-error-correction protocols. In this work, we demonstrate confidence-aware readout of $^{171}\mathrm{Yb}$ atoms in optical tweezers using a discriminative classifier. Rather than forcing each atom-site image directly into a hard binary outcome, the proposed readout produces a measurement reliability score. This score is produced by a logistic-regression classifier trained on features derived from both the total photon count and the spatial pattern of fluorescence at each site. The resulting classifier achieves the same readout fidelity with approximately half the imaging time. At an exposure of 10 ms, it achieves $99.83\%$ readout fidelity, comparable to the $99.82\%$ achieved by conventional photon-count thresholding at 20 ms. Importantly, the classifier score enables low-confidence outcomes to be converted into measurement-level erasures, leaving fewer residual unflagged errors at a fixed erasure budget. This improvement is further accompanied by strong false-positive suppression, which is important for downstream operations such as atom rearrangement where false positives can create target defects. Monte Carlo rearrangement simulations show that the reduced false-positive rate and confidence-based erasure conversion improve predicted defect-free assembly performance. This work establishes confidence-aware readout using a discriminative classifier as a practical paradigm for fast and scalable neutral-atom quantum computing.

summaries.en: A logistic-regression classifier using photon-count and spatial-fluorescence features read out 171Yb tweezer-array images with 99.
summaries.zh: 一种结合光子计数与荧光空间特征进行训练的 logistic 回归分类器，在 10 ms 曝光下对 171Yb 光镊阵列图像实现了 99.
summaries.ja: 光子数と蛍光の空間パターンから得た特徴量で学習したロジスティック回帰分類器により、171Yb光ピンセットアレイ画像の読み出しを10 msの露光で99.

title: Equivalence and origin of discrepancies between transfer matrix method and multiple reflection model of surface induced second harmonic generation
abstract: Second harmonic generation (SHG) spectroscopy is a sensitive tool to study surfaces and interfaces in thin films. To understand the layer boundaries and interpret the measured data, it is essential to use a theoretical model describing the SHG generation in the thin film. The transfer matrix method and multiple reflection model are two numerical techniques which have been commonly utilized in the calculation of surface-induced SHG. Here, we demonstrate that, despite the expected equivalence of the approaches, the two methods can lead to controversial results for the same input properties and second-order susceptibility tensors. The discrepancies resulting in different SHG intensity from both methods are caused by inconsistent numerical implementation of the interface SHG. We describe the conditions for the implementation to achieve the equivalence between the two models. Moreover, we identify the physical constraint that has to be imposed in numerical implementation to get identical results from both methods.

summaries.en: This paper demonstrates that the transfer matrix method and multiple reflection model can yield contradictory surface-induced SHG intensities for identical inputs due to inconsistent numerical implementation of interface SHG, and it specifies the conditions and physical constraint required to achieve equivalence between the two models.
summaries.zh: 本文表明，由于界面SHG的数值实现不一致，传递矩阵法与多次反射模型在相同输入下会给出相互矛盾的表面诱导SHG强度，并给出了实现两种模型等价所需的条件和物理约束。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、界面SHGの数値実装の不一致により、伝達行列法と多重反射モデルが同一の入力に対して矛盾する表面誘起SHG強度を与え得ることを示し、両モデルの等価性を実現するために必要な条件と物理的制約を明らかにする。

title: 1.2 dB Insertion Loss in a Monolithically Integrated Silicon Mach-Zehnder Optical Isolator Using Stoichiometric Ce:YIG
abstract: Integrated optical isolators play a crucial role in photonic integrated circuits (PICs) by effectively stabilizing optical signals, making them indispensable components for advanced photonic systems. However, integrated magneto-optical (MO) isolators suffer from their high insertion loss, which is mainly caused by the relatively low FoM of Ce:YIG MO thin films deposited on silicon. Here, we show that film stoichiometry plays a key role in controlling the FoM of Ce:YIG. We observed garnet phase Fe-rich and Ce-rich nano-clusters in non-stoichiometric Ce:YIG. By using an iron-deficient target, we demonstrated that nearly stoichiometric Ce:YIG films on Si(100) could be fabricated, eliminating the nano-cluster defects. Consequently, the film exhibited a saturation Faraday rotation angle of -5523 deg/cm and a figure of merit of 72.7 deg/dB, which is 1.7 times higher compared to nonstoichiometric films. An MZI-type optical isolator on SiN fabricated by this method demonstrated a record low insertion loss of 1.2 dB and isolation ratio of 27.6 dB at 1556 nm wavelength. Our results provide an important step toward the practical application of integrated MO nonreciprocal photonic devices.

summaries.en: By using an iron-deficient target to deposit nearly stoichiometric Ce:YIG on Si(100), nano-cluster defects are eliminated, yielding a figure of merit of 72.
summaries.zh: 通过使用缺铁靶材在Si(100)上沉积近乎化学计量比的Ce:YIG，消除了纳米团簇缺陷，使品质因数达到72.
summaries.ja: 鉄欠乏ターゲットを用いてSi(100)上にほぼ化学量論組成のCe:YIGを成膜することでナノクラスター欠陥を除去し、性能指数72.

title: A Highly Tunable (Ti,Zr)N$_x$-Based MIM Plasmonic Sensor for Multidomain Biological, Chemical, and Physical Sensing
abstract: Metal-Insulator-Metal (MIM) plasmonic refractive index (RI) sensors have attracted considerable attention for label-free, real-time analyte detection; however, their reliance on noble metals such as gold and silver imposes fundamental constraints on tunability, thermal stability, and CMOS process compatibility. In this work, we propose a novel MIM plasmonic RI sensor based on a square ring resonator with embedded circular nanorods, employing the ternary nitride (Ti,Zr)N$_x$ as the plasmonic material, marking its first application in a MIM sensing platform. Compared to binary nitrides and other alternative plasmonic materials reported in the literature, (Ti,Zr)N$_x$ offers broader compositional tunability and greater flexibility in tailoring the optical response while remaining fully CMOS-compatible. The sensor is validated across a comprehensive range of biosensing and physicochemical analyte scenarios, including glucose monitoring for diabetes assessment, hemoglobin-based anemia classification across four severity levels, simultaneous discrimination of five major blood constituents, and cancer cell identification across six tissue types. For physical and chemical sensing, the structure achieves an air pressure sensitivity of 6.158 nm/MPa with negligible thermal cross-sensitivity, and a CO$_2$ detection sensitivity of 330.12 pm/ppm via polyhexamethylene biguanide (PHMB) functionalization, which is the highest reported among comparable structures in the literature. The proposed sensor achieves a maximum RI sensitivity of 2146.496 nm/RIU with a detection limit of $4.669 \times 10^{-7}$ RIU, outperforming previously reported CMOS-compatible plasmonic RI sensors.

summaries.en: The paper presents a CMOS-compatible metal-insulator-metal plasmonic refractive index sensor based on a square ring resonator with embedded circular nanorods using the ternary nitride (Ti,Zr)Nx, achieving a maximum sensitivity of 2146.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种基于方形环谐振器与嵌入式圆形纳米棒的CMOS兼容金属-绝缘体-金属等离激元折射率传感器，采用三元氮化物(Ti,Zr)Nx作为等离激元材料，实现了2146.
summaries.ja: 本論文は、三元窒化物(Ti,Zr)Nxをプラズモン材料として用いた正方形リング共振器と埋め込み円形ナノロッド構造のCMOS互換金属-絶縁体-金属プラズモン屈折率センサーを提案し、最大感度2146.

title: Programmable Broadband Polarization-Preserving Optical Delay Line with Faraday Mirrors
abstract: We report a broadband optical delay line programmable for delays up to 1 {\mu}s with nanosecond resolution, while preserving an arbitrary and unknown polarization state of the original light. The delay line comprises bidirectional pass in cascaded segments of standard single-mode fibers, along with terminal reflection from Faraday mirrors (FMs) at both ends. Each segment contains either a short path or a long path, selected by an optical switch. The FMs auto-compensate for random polarization fluctuations introduced by the optical fibers, thereby restoring the initial polarization state. Broadband operation of the delay line was assessed by investigating dispersion of both the fiber and the FMs. Surprisingly, we found that the two-pass propagation in the fiber can mitigate dispersive distortion introduced by the FM. Numerical experiments demonstrated that the output polarization state of the delay line has a mean fidelity better than 99% over a range of 50-nm deviation from the central wavelength. Remarkably, the mean fidelity often surpasses that in the absence of the fiber itself.

summaries.en: A programmable broadband optical delay line using cascaded single-mode fiber segments and Faraday mirrors achieves delays up to 1 μs with nanosecond resolution while preserving an arbitrary unknown input polarization, with two-pass fiber propagation mitigating Faraday-mirror dispersion and yielding mean output polarization fidelity above 99% over a 50-nm wavelength range.
summaries.zh: 一种采用级联单模光纤段和法拉第镜的可编程宽带光延迟线可实现高达1微秒、纳秒分辨率的延迟，同时保持任意未知的输入偏振态，其中光纤双程传播可缓解法拉第镜的色散，在50纳米波长范围内输出偏振态平均保真度超过99%。
summaries.ja: 縦続接続した単一モードファイバ区間とファラデーミラーを用いたプログラマブル広帯域光遅延線は、任意の未知の偏光状態を保存しつつナノ秒分解能で最大1μsの遅延を実現し、ファイバの2回通過がファラデーミラーの分散を緩和して50nmの波長範囲で平均偏光忠実度99%以上を得る。

title: Localized Strain Tuning of Second-Harmonic Generation in MoS2 Monolayers and Bilayers
abstract: We investigate the modulation of second-harmonic generation (SHG) in CVD-grown MoS2 monolayers and few-layer flakes through localized mechanical deformation applied by an atomic force microscope (AFM) tip. MoS2 membranes suspended over microstructured Si3N4 substrates allow simultaneous measurements of force and SHG intensity during controlled approach and retraction cycles. Suspended regions exhibit enhanced SHG relative to substrate-supported regions, with pronounced suppression near the clamping boundaries. While the SHG response during compressive loading varies among individual membranes, adhesion-mediated pulling during retraction consistently reduces the SHG intensity until tip detachment, when the signal recovers. By correlating the optical modulation with the measured pull-off force and a phenomenological estimate of effective strain, we obtain a characteristic sensitivity of approximately 12% SHG modulation per 1% effective strain, with comparable behavior in monolayers and bilayers. These findings reveal adhesion-mediated mechanical deformation as a distinct and reversible mechanism for controlling nonlinear optical emission in atomically thin membranes.

summaries.en: Localized mechanical deformation applied by an AFM tip reversibly modulates second-harmonic generation in suspended CVD-grown MoS2 monolayers and bilayers with a characteristic sensitivity of about 12% SHG modulation per 1% effective strain.
summaries.zh: 通过原子力显微镜针尖施加的局域机械形变可逆地调控悬浮CVD生长MoS2单层和双层中的二次谐波产生，其特征灵敏度约为每1%有效应变引起12%的SHG调制。
summaries.ja: AFM探針による局所的な機械的変形は、懸架されたCVD成長MoS2単層および二層の第二高調波発生を可逆的に変調し、その特性感度は有効ひずみ1%あたり約12%のSHG変調である。

title: State-selective dynamical freezing in driven Rydberg atom chains
abstract: Dynamical freezing, the near-complete suppression of dynamics at special drive frequencies, offers a route to mitigating Floquet heating in periodically driven quantum systems. In interacting systems, however, the energy cost of each transition depends on the many-body configuration, so that the freezing condition itself becomes state dependent. We study this dependence in periodically driven Rydberg atom chains under single- and bi-frequency driving. Using Floquet perturbation theory, we show that each spin flip is characterised by a single interference amplitude set by its local interaction shift, and that a state freezes only where the amplitudes of all its available flips vanish simultaneously. This picture accounts quantitatively for the shift and proliferation of freezing frequencies with interatomic spacing and for the response of entire families of initial states, which are sorted by a single local motif. Freezing is strong only within a window of spacings bounded by interaction tails on one side and nearest-neighbour excitation facilitation on the other, outside of which the advantage of bi-frequency driving is lost. In the regime of large detuning amplitude, where freezing points are numerous and the perturbative description is controlled, this window leaves almost no room for the PXP limit.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el)

summaries.en: State-selective dynamical freezing in periodically driven Rydberg atom chains arises because each spin flip has a local interaction-shift-dependent interference amplitude, so a many-body state freezes only when all its available flip amplitudes vanish simultaneously, and strong freezing occurs only within a bounded window of interatomic spacings.
summaries.zh: 在周期性驱动的里德堡原子链中，态选择性动力学冻结源于每次自旋翻转的干涉振幅取决于局部相互作用位移，因此多体态只有在所有可用翻转振幅同时消失时才会冻结，而强冻结仅出现在由相互作用尾部与最近邻激发促进所界定的有限原子间距窗口内。
summaries.ja: 周期的に駆動されたリュードベリ原子鎖における状態選択的動的凍結は、各スピンフリップの干渉振幅が局所的な相互作用シフトに依存するために生じ、多体状態は利用可能なすべてのフリップ振幅が同時に消失する場合にのみ凍結し、強い凍結は相互作用の裾と最近接励起促進によって挟まれた有限の原子間隔領域でのみ現れる。

title: Foliated surface codes for optimal skip-gate leakage correction
abstract: Skip-gate leakage --- such as atom loss in neutral-atom arrays or trapped ions, or photon loss in superconducting dual-rail qubits --- takes a qubit out of its computational subspace and removes subsequent gates acting on it. If leakage is only detectable end-of-the-line at qubit measurement, error correction circuits must be designed to periodically measure all qubits, as in SWAP-based circuits and foliation. We show that the best SWAP-based surface code, although optimal against space-like skip-gate leakage errors, is suboptimal against time-like leakage errors. By optimal, we mean that the code corrects as many leakage errors as it can detect. Remarkably, we find that the foliated surface code is optimal against both space- and time-like error configurations. We support our findings with numerical simulations. Under two-qubit gate leakage with probability 0.5%, foliation suppresses time-like errors in a distance-4 rotated stability experiment by 1380(50) per two added rounds, compared to 63(1) for the best SWAP-based circuit. In memory, the two are comparable. Under an experimentally motivated neutral-atom noise model, we find that foliation outperforms SWAP-based circuits in stability for both rotated and unrotated code geometries. This holds true for a parameter sweep that takes the neutral-atom noise model from being dominated by computational errors to atom loss. Interestingly, a SWAP-based circuit for unrotated code memory performs best when computational noise dominates over loss. Our work motivates co-designing error correction circuits with logical operations: preferring foliation when time-like errors dominate and SWAP-based circuits when space-like errors dominate.

summaries.en: The foliated surface code optimally corrects both space-like and time-like skip-gate leakage errors, outperforming the best SWAP-based circuit against time-like errors—suppressing them by 1380(50) per two added rounds versus 63(1) at 0.
summaries.zh: 分叶表面码能同时最优地纠正类空间和类时间的跳跃门泄漏错误，在类时间错误上优于最佳的基于SWAP的电路——在0.
summaries.ja: フォリエーテッド表面符号は空間的および時間的スキップゲート漏れ誤差の両方を最適に訂正し、時間的誤差に対しては最良のSWAPベース回路を上回り、2量子ビットゲート漏れ率0.

title: Mitigating large circuits with a learned small-circuit mitigator
abstract: Learning-based quantum error mitigation infers noise-free results from noisy measurement data. However, exact training labels become prohibitively expensive to compute as circuits grow, and the generalization capability of a trained model to infer accurate results on circuits of depths and sizes it was not trained on poses a challenge. We show that circuit cutting allows such a model to be reused on circuits larger than those it was trained on. We benchmark this approach against zero-noise extrapolation, Clifford data regression, and probabilistic error cancellation on simulated circuits several times wider and deeper than the training circuits. On random-circuit chains, the fragment-wise mitigator removes most of the reconstructed error. For a holographic Ising-chain eigensolver under a fixed shot budget, it recovers most of the noise-induced energy error, close to 90\% or more, and outperforms Clifford data regression and probabilistic error cancellation. Since the mitigator is trained once and needs no additional circuits or noise amplification at inference, its cost is paid up front rather than for every new circuit. The approach is also modular. Any improvement to the small-circuit mitigator, such as retraining on larger fragments or on device-specific noise, carries over directly to every circuit that can be cut into such fragments. Our proposal thus offers a practical route to bringing learned error mitigation to quantum computations far beyond the reach of exact training labels, provided they can be partitioned with a moderate number of cuts.

summaries.en: Circuit cutting enables a learned small-circuit error mitigator, trained once on small circuits, to be reused on circuits several times wider and deeper, recovering most noise-induced error and outperforming zero-noise extrapolation, Clifford data regression, and probabilistic error cancellation under a fixed shot budget.
summaries.zh: 电路切割使一个只需在小电路上训练一次的学习型小电路误差缓解器能够复用于宽度和深度达数倍的更大电路，从而恢复大部分噪声引起的误差，并在固定测量预算下优于零噪声外推、Clifford数据回归和概率误差消除。
summaries.ja: 回路切断により、小規模回路で一度だけ学習した小回路誤り緩和器を数倍広く深い回路に再利用でき、ノイズ起因の誤差の大部分を回復し、固定ショット予算下でゼロノイズ外挿、クリフォードデータ回帰、確率的誤り消去を上回る。

title: Coherent Control of Single-Photon Emission in Broadband Plasmonic Resonators
abstract: Encoding phase information with quantum emitters in metallic optical nanocavities is challenging due to ultrafast relaxation induced by the broadband nature of the plasmonic near field. Using macroscopic quantum electrodynamics theory, we demonstrate that an individual emitter strongly coupled to a plasmonic nanocavity field that is driven by a pulsed laser with frequency comb spectrum undergoes spontaneous emission of well-resolved one-photon pulses whose amplitude scales quadratically with the number of frequency comb components due to coherent accumulation, and ultrashort non-exponential temporal profiles with duration set by the light-matter coupling strength. Conditions are discussed for exponentially suppressing the probability of two or more emission events within the lifetime of the coupled emitter-nanocavity system. The spectral signatures of the optimal one-photon wavepackets are discussed. This work paves the way for the development of ultrafast laser-triggered single-photon emitters using atoms and molecules in optical nanocavities.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Chemical Physics (physics.chem-ph)

summaries.en: Using macroscopic quantum electrodynamics, the authors show that an individual emitter strongly coupled to a broadband plasmonic nanocavity driven by a frequency-comb pulsed laser emits well-resolved single-photon pulses whose amplitude scales quadratically with the number of comb components through coherent accumulation and whose ultrashort non-exponential temporal profiles are set by the light-matter coupling strength, with conditions discussed for exponentially suppressing multi-photon emission.
summaries.zh: 利用宏观量子电动力学理论，作者证明与宽带等离激元纳米腔强耦合的单个发射体在频率梳脉冲激光驱动下，会通过相干累积发射出振幅随频率梳分量数目呈二次方增长、时间轮廓为非指数且超短并由光与物质耦合强度决定的清晰单光子脉冲，并讨论了指数抑制多光子发射事件的条件。
summaries.ja: 巨視的量子電気力学理論を用いて、周波数コムパルスレーザーで駆動される広帯域プラズモンナノキャビティと強結合した単一エミッタが、コヒーレント蓄積により周波数コム成分数の二乗で振幅が増大し、光物質結合強度で決まる超短非指数時間波形を持つ明確な単一光子パルスを放出することを示し、多光子放出確率を指数関数的に抑制する条件を議論した。

title: photon number correlations in harmonics driven with classical and quantum light
abstract: Recent reports of nonclassical intensity correlations in harmonic generation raised questions about whether strong harmonic correlations necessarily imply genuinely quantum behaviour. Here, we compare the low-photon-number perturbative harmonic generation driven by classical and bright squeezed vacuum sources. The latter generates strong auto- and cross-correlations in the harmonic spectrum. Cauchy-Schwarz inequality and heralding measurements show that the cross-correlations are fully classical and can be explained by the common fluctuations from the driving field. A visible scaling of the measured correlation function with mean harmonic flux is observed, which is well-explained by a click detector-response model.

summaries.en: Photon-number correlation measurements and Cauchy-Schwarz inequality and heralding analyses show that the strong auto- and cross-correlations in harmonics generated by bright squeezed vacuum are fully classical and explained by common fluctuations of the driving field, with the observed scaling of the correlation function with mean harmonic flux captured by a click detector-response model.
summaries.zh: 光子数关联测量以及柯西-施瓦茨不等式和预报分析表明，由明亮压缩真空驱动的谐波中强烈的自关联和互关联完全是经典的，可由驱动场的共同涨落解释，并且观测到的关联函数随平均谐波通量的标度关系可由点击探测器响应模型很好地描述。
summaries.ja: 光子数相関測定ならびにコーシー・シュワルツ不等式とヘラルディング解析により、明るいスクイーズド真空で発生した高調波の強い自己相関および相互相関は完全に古典的であり、駆動場の共通揺らぎで説明でき、平均高調波フラックスに対する相関関数のスケーリングはクリック検出器応答モデルでよく記述されることが示された。

title: The resource--invariant gap: a protected Floquet invariant need not protect Wigner negativity
abstract: Topological invariants constrain a driven Floquet generator, yet whether they protect a transient nonlinear bosonic resource remains open. We track boundary Wigner negativity of an even cat state in a chiral Floquet Su--Schrieffer--Heeger chain with boundary Kerr nonlinearity and structured loss. The quasienergy windings remain quantized at every chain length, yet the matched sector contrast flips sign when the chain grows under index-end shielding and is null within $3\times 10^{-5}$ under uniform loss at $t=T$ for $d\le 0.5$. Prepared and shielded on the physical dangling end, the contrast remains positive, modulated by local dimer return rather than set by the invariant. A three-site causal light cone and a boundary-Laplacian erosion law trace the flip to strong-bond bulk exposure: the sign is set by where the bulk-rate loss sits relative to the prepared site, not by chain length. We call this decoupling the resource--invariant gap.

summaries.en: The paper shows that a quantized Floquet topological invariant does not protect boundary Wigner negativity in a Kerr nonlinear Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain with structured loss, since the sign of the matched sector contrast depends on where bulk-rate loss sits relative to the prepared site rather than on the invariant, a decoupling the authors term the resource-invariant gap.
summaries.zh: 本文表明，在具有边界克尔非线性和结构化损耗的手性Floquet Su-Schrieffer-Heeger链中，量子化的Floquet拓扑不变量并不能保护边界Wigner负性，因为匹配扇区对比度的符号取决于体损耗相对于制备位点的位置而非该不变量，作者将这种解耦称为资源-不变量间隙。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、境界カー非線形性と構造化損失を持つカイラルFloquet Su–Schrieffer–Heeger鎖において、量子化されたFloquetトポロジカル不変量が境界Wigner負性を保護しないことを示し、整合セクターのコントラストの符号は不変量ではなくバルク損失率が準備サイトに対してどこに位置するかで決まるという、著者らが資源–不変量ギャップと呼ぶ乖離を明らかにした。

title: Compact and Long-Term Stable Polarization Entangled Photon-Pair Source
abstract: We present a robust, compact polarization-entangled photon-pair source based on bulk optics that achieves long-term stability, a spectral pair generation rate of $4.24 \times 10^6$ pairs s$^{-1}$ mW$^{-1}$ nm$^{-1}$ constant for pump powers up to 700 mW, an intrinsic heralding efficiency of 59.8% , and a polarization contrast visibility of 99.6%. The source is mechanically designed for vibrational robustness, employing an engineered base plate and a reduced optical layout for less alignment sensitivity and complexity. It operates at telecom wavelengths in C-band with a typical type-0 SPDC spectral output of 70 nm width. We demonstrate its integration into a deployed entanglement-based QKD system that bridges the gap between laboratory prototypes and practical quantum communication hardware.

summaries.en: The paper presents a compact, vibration-robust bulk-optics source of polarization-entangled photon pairs at telecom C-band wavelengths that achieves long-term stability, a spectral pair generation rate of 4.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种基于体光学元件的紧凑型、抗振动偏振纠缠光子对源，工作在电信C波段，具有长期稳定性，在高达700 mW泵浦功率下光谱对产生率为4.
summaries.ja: 本論文は、通信C帯波長で動作する、長期安定性を備えた堅牢でコンパクトなバルク光学系ベースの偏光もつれ光子対源を提示し、最大700 mWのポンプパワーまで一定の4.

title: Where to Hide the Traps: Robust Placement in Verifiable Blind Quantum Computation
abstract: Trap-based verification of blind quantum computation hides test qubits among the positions of a measurement pattern, and existing protocols choose the trap configuration without regard to the delegated computation. We model trap placement as a zero-sum game between a client, who chooses a trap distribution, and a server, who chooses where to apply a Pauli deviation, with a damage profile $w$ and a per-trap detection constant $c$. Since the client cannot know how damage from several positions combines, we solve the game for all monotone subadditive damage functions consistent with $w$ at once. In a single round, placing traps in proportion to $w$ guarantees soundness error $1-c/\|w\|_1$ and is optimal up to a factor $1+\max_iw_i$, while the optimistic solution can fail completely. Over $T$ test rounds, the error decays exponentially against a server that repeats the same deviation, but a general server can keep it at $\Theta(\|w\|_1/(cT))$, and against such servers the damage-weighted placement is exactly optimal. Damage profiles follow from the flow of the pattern: for brickwork patterns with $m=4h+1$ columns, only $(2h+1)^2$ positions can affect a decision qubit, whatever the width. With $k$ traps per round, placing them on this set reduces the number of test rounds by the same factor as for a single trap; with unrestricted trap sets and flat damage we recover the known optimality of fractional coloring. Finally, trap statistics certify the aggregate damage with a number of rounds independent of the number of positions $N$, whereas locating the damage requires $\Omega(N\epsilon^{-2}\log\delta^{-1})$ rounds.

summaries.en: Trap placement in verifiable blind quantum computation is modeled as a zero-sum game, yielding damage-weighted trap distributions that are optimal or near-optimal for monotone subadditive damage functions and that exploit brickwork pattern flow to localize relevant positions.
summaries.zh: 该文将可验证盲量子计算中的陷阱放置建模为零和博弈，得出按损伤加权的陷阱分布，该分布对单调次可加损伤函数最优或近最优，并利用砖砌模式的信息流定位相关位置。
summaries.ja: 検証可能なブラインド量子計算におけるトラップ配置をゼロサムゲームとしてモデル化し、単調劣加法的な損傷関数に対して最適またはほぼ最適となる損傷重み付きトラップ分布を導き、ブリックワークパターンのフローを用いて関連位置を特定する。

title: Multi-port few-photon diodes
abstract: We investigate single- and two-photon scattering dynamics in a system comprising two one dimensional chiral waveguides coupled to a dissipative Rydberg atom pair. By employing the Laplace transform method, we analytically solve the scattering problem and characterize the transport properties. Our results demonstrate robust perfect single-photon diode effects in this system with or without dissipation, exhibiting unity transmittance in the forward direction and zero transmittance in the backward direction. Unlike previous studies where perfect nonreciprocity requires a specific dissipation rate, our scheme achieves this effect without fine-tuning such parameters. Furthermore, we extend the nonreciprocal transport to multi-port configurations at the one and two-photon levels. The system exhibits pronounced photon nonreciprocal behavior in lossy and lossless scenarios, without the need for precise parameter matching. This work provides a robust platform for on-chip nonreciprocal photonic devices.

summaries.en: Researchers analytically show that two chiral waveguides coupled to a dissipative Rydberg atom pair realize robust perfect single-photon diode effects and extend nonreciprocal transport to multi-port configurations at the one- and two-photon levels without fine-tuning dissipation or precise parameter matching.
summaries.zh: 研究者通过解析方法表明，两条手性波导与一个耗散里德堡原子对耦合的系统可实现稳健的完美单光子二极管效应，并在单光子和双光子层面上将非互易传输扩展到多端口配置，而无需精细调节耗散率或精确匹配参数。
summaries.ja: 研究者は、2本のカイラル導波路を散逸性のリュードベリ原子対に結合した系において、散逸率の微調整や厳密なパラメータ整合を必要とせずに堅牢な完全単光子ダイオード効果が実現し、単光子・二光子レベルで多ポート構成へ非相反輸送を拡張できることを解析的に示した。

title: A single-photon quantum sensor via single-atom cavity-QED
abstract: We describe a cavity-QED sensor using an optical probe with exactly one photon per pulse. This has a better sensitivity than a coherent pulse with the same average power when no global coherent phase reference is available. The sensor measurement is based on the estimation of the Raman-controlled absorption probability of a single-photon pulse. We use the Fock state master equation to determine the dynamics and performance of the Raman-controlled absorption of a single photon pulse and optimise the sensitivity using machine learning. Two examples are presented; (1) the target parameter is the detuning of the two-level system itself, and (2) the target parameters describe a remote reflecting cavity. In the second case, the scheme does not require a shared coherent phase reference.

summaries.en: The paper presents a single-photon cavity-QED sensor that estimates Raman-controlled absorption probabilities of exactly one photon per pulse and uses the Fock state master equation with machine-learning optimization to outperform coherent pulses of equal average power when no global coherent phase reference is available.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种单光子腔QED传感器，通过估计每个脉冲中恰好一个光子的拉曼控制吸收概率，并结合Fock态主方程与机器学习优化，在缺乏全局相干相位参考时其灵敏度优于同等平均功率的相干脉冲。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、1パルスあたり正確に1光子のラマン制御吸収確率を推定する単一光子キャビティQEDセンサーを提案し、フォック状態マスター方程式と機械学習による最適化を用いることで、大域的なコヒーレント位相基準が利用できない場合に同一平均パワーのコヒーレントパルスより優れた感度を達成する。

title: On-demand frequency-entangled microwave biphotons from a transmon-resonator dimer
abstract: We propose a superconducting circuit QED source of on-demand frequency-entangled microwave photon pairs, with one photon emitted into each of two separate waveguides, enabling individual manipulation. The design is based on a transmon-resonator dimer, which consists of two transmon-resonator subsystems coupled through a cross-Kerr interaction. We outline a viable circuit-QED realization in which the required cross-Kerr interaction is implemented using Josephson-junction couplers. To analyze the emission dynamics, we derive and numerically solve the set of evolution equations that enable tracking the evolution of the joint spectral intensity of photons. We characterize the resulting photon-number correlations, frequency anticorrelation, and spectral entanglement. By varying the coupling strengths, we obtain biphotons with distinct joint spectral intensities and Schmidt spectra, ranging from broadly distributed multimode entanglement to states dominated by two nearly equally weighted Schmidt contributions. In the latter regime, optimizing the transmon-resonator coupling and detuning yields an output biphoton state that has fidelity $F \approx 0.956$ with a two-dimensional maximally entangled state. Restricting the local target modes to separated frequency bins yields a fidelity $F_\mathrm{bin} \approx 0.949$, indicating that the output state closely approximates a frequency-bin Bell pair. Thus, the proposed microwave biphoton source provides a route toward distributing frequency-encoded quantum resources between remote superconducting nodes.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a transmon-resonator dimer circuit-QED source that emits on-demand frequency-entangled microwave photon pairs into separate waveguides, achieving fidelity of about 0.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种基于transmon-谐振器二聚体的电路QED源，可向两条独立波导按需发射频率纠缠的微波光子对，并通过调节耦合强度与失谐实现与二维最大纠缠态约0.
summaries.ja: 本論文は、トランズモン-共振器ダイマーを用いた回路QED源により、2本の独立した導波路へオンデマンドで周波数もつれマイクロ波光子対を放出し、結合強度と離調の調整により2次元最大もつれ状態に対して約0.

title: Extraction erases the gain: cavity loss bounds dynamical-Casimir metrology at ultrastrong coupling
abstract: Ultrastrong light--matter coupling dresses the vacuum with virtual photons whose response to the coupling strength exceeds that of any coherent probe, yet these photons never leave the cavity and cannot be detected. A parametric drive at the dynamical-Casimir resonance converts them into real photons that a detector can collect. We show that this conversion is self-limiting: converting the virtual photons of an ultrastrongly coupled probe into real, extractable photons opens the cavity port that removes them, so the retained metrological gain is set by the accumulated cavity loss rather than by the pure-state ceiling. In the driven quantum Rabi model the pure-state quantum Fisher information on the coupling reaches $1.7\times10^{5}$ times the coherent baseline; at a cavity linewidth of $246$~MHz, typical of coplanar-waveguide flux-qubit circuits, master-equation dynamics retain $0.96\%$ of it. In a 32-qubit Dicke model the retained fraction is $2.6\%$ at the largest photon basis computed. Eighteen lossy configurations from both models fall on one curve of the accumulated loss, the product of linewidth and interrogation time, which halves the retained information at $0.13$. The extraction cost, not the lossless ceiling, is the figure of merit for any protocol that reads bound vacuum correlations through a lossy port.

summaries.en: Converting dynamical-Casimir-generated virtual photons into extractable real photons opens the cavity port and erases much of the metrological gain, so the retained quantum Fisher information is bounded by accumulated cavity loss (linewidth times interrogation time) rather than by the lossless pure-state ceiling.
summaries.zh: 将动态卡西米尔共振产生的虚拟光子转换为可提取的真实光子会打开腔端口并抹去大部分计量增益，因此保留的量子费舍尔信息受累积腔损耗（线宽与探测时间之积）限制，而非由无损纯态上限决定。
summaries.ja: 動的カシミール共鳴で生じた仮想光子を取り出し可能な実光子に変換するとキャビティポートが開いて計測利得の大半が失われるため、保持される量子フィッシャー情報は無損失の純粋状態上限ではなく、累積キャビティ損失（線幅と問い合わせ時間の積）によって制限される。

title: Proposal for a cat-cluster-state machine gun
abstract: Non-Gaussian bosonic states such as the Schrödinger cat states are essential for continuous-variable quantum-information processing. A convenient and deterministic process for generating cat states is through the use of a Rabi interaction between a single bosonic mode and a spin which facilitates a state-dependent displacement. The lack of a Rabi interaction for propagating optical photons has rendered optical cat states elusive. Here, we show that the complex nonlinear scattering dynamics of a single-mode squeezed-vacuum state interacting with a quantum emitter can be engineered to produce a Rabi interaction between a quantum emitter and a propagating photon mode while the contributions from other orthogonal modes destructively interfere. Our protocol can deterministically prepare large-scale high-fidelity squeezed cat states from squeezed-vacuum pulses and is robust to photon loss due to spontaneous emission to non-guided modes. Extending to scattering multiple input squeezed-vacuum pulses off the quantum emitter, we propose generating linear cluster state strings with logical qubits encoded as squeezed cat states, which we refer as the cat cluster state. Our interaction scheme can potentially produce strings of entangled cat states at GHz rates using semiconductor quantum dots.

summaries.en: The paper proposes engineering nonlinear scattering of squeezed-vacuum pulses off a quantum emitter to realize an effective Rabi interaction between the emitter and a propagating photon mode, enabling deterministic generation of high-fidelity squeezed cat states and, by scattering multiple pulses, strings of linear cluster states with logical qubits encoded as squeezed cat states at GHz rates using semiconductor quantum dots.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出通过工程设计压缩真空脉冲与量子发射体之间的复杂非线性散射动力学，实现量子发射体与传播光子模式之间的有效拉比相互作用，从而确定性地制备高保真度的压缩猫态，并通过散射多个输入脉冲生成以压缩猫态编码逻辑量子比特的线性簇态串，利用半导体量子点有望以GHz速率产生纠缠猫态串。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、圧縮真空パルスと量子エミッタ間の複雑な非線形散乱ダイナミクスを設計することで、量子エミッタと伝搬光子モードの間の有効なラビ相互作用を実現し、高忠実度の圧縮猫状態を決定論的に生成するとともに、複数の入力パルスを散乱させることで圧縮猫状態を論理量子ビットとして符号化した線形クラスター状態列を生成し、半導体量子ドットを用いてGHzレートで絡み合った猫状態列を生成できる可能性を示す。

title: 500 Hz atom-atom entanglement distribution over metropolitan-scale fibers
abstract: Quantum networks and repeaters are among the most promising routes to scale up quantum information systems. Nevertheless, various aspects still require significant improvement to achieve practical realization. Multiplexing can enhance the performance in many fundamental steps, thus emerging as a critical strategy for the realization of quantum repeaters. Currently, a major bottleneck in realizing functional quantum repeaters is heralded entanglement distribution over longdistance elementary links, as neither of the two dominant protocols-single-photon nor two-photon interference-can simultaneously achieve high efficiency and strong robustness. Here, we address this challenge by experimentally realizing a method that unifies the efficiency and robustness. By harnessing two 15 * 15 quantum memory arrays, we generate remote matter-matter entanglement at a rate of 546 Hz over 20 km of fiber without active phase stabilization. This rate exceeds that of two-photon and single-photon schemes by factors of 75,932 and 23, respectively, establishing a new benchmark for entangling speed over metropolitan-scale distances and enabling semi-deterministic entanglement distribution. Inherently compatible with multiplexed quantum repeater architectures, our scheme offers a promising approach towards the realization of future high-performance distributed quantum systems.

summaries.en: Using two 15×15 quantum memory arrays, the authors distribute remote atom-atom entanglement at 546 Hz over 20 km of fiber without active phase stabilization, surpassing two-photon and single-photon schemes by factors of 75,932 and 23 and setting a new benchmark for metropolitan-scale entanglement distribution compatible with multiplexed quantum repeaters.
summaries.zh: 作者利用两个15×15量子存储阵列，在20公里光纤上无需主动相位稳定即实现了546 Hz的远距离原子-原子纠缠分发，速率分别比双光子和单光子方案高出75,932倍和23倍，为大都市尺度纠缠分发树立了新基准，并与多路复用量子中继器架构兼容。
summaries.ja: 著者らは2つの15×15量子メモリアレイを用いて、20 kmの光ファイバー上で能動的な位相安定化なしに546 Hzの遠隔原子間エンタングルメント分布を実現し、二光子方式および単一光子方式をそれぞれ75,932倍と23倍上回る速度で都市規模のエンタングルメント分布の新たな基準を打ち立て、多重化量子リピータ構造との互換性を示した。

title: Impact of structured noise on bosonic quantum error correction
abstract: Bosonic quantum error correction relies on an accurate description of single-photon loss dissipation using an ideal annihilation operator, under which correctable loss errors act equivalently on different logical code states. In realistic weakly nonlinear bosonic modes, however, coupling to a structured environment can render photon loss Fock-state dependent, thereby modifying the effective dissipation operator and deforming the associated error space. Here, we experimentally investigate this effect in a three-dimensional circuit quantum electrodynamics system. By injecting spectrally engineered environmental noise into a weakly nonlinear oscillator, we observe pronounced frequency selectivity in the measured Fock-state dynamics. While the long-time transition rates converge to the Markovian limit, the transient dynamics display distinctly non-Markovian behavior, in quantitative agreement with a second-order time-convolutionless theory. By applying narrowband noise to a binomially encoded logical qubit, we further demonstrate Fock-state-dependent dissipation channels that drive logical states beyond the nominally correctable error space. These results establish structured environmental noise as a mechanism for deforming photon-loss errors in weakly nonlinear bosonic systems and highlight the need to incorporate realistic, state-dependent dissipation into the design and characterization of bosonic quantum error correction.

summaries.en: This paper experimentally shows in a 3D circuit QED system that spectrally engineered environmental noise makes photon loss Fock-state dependent in a weakly nonlinear bosonic mode, producing non-Markovian transient dynamics and, under narrowband noise applied to a binomially encoded logical qubit, dissipation channels that drive logical states beyond the nominally correctable error space.
summaries.zh: 本文在三维电路量子电动力学系统中实验证明，经频谱工程化的环境噪声会使弱非线性玻色模式中的光子损耗依赖于Fock态，产生非马尔可夫的瞬态动力学，并且当窄带噪声作用于二项式编码的逻辑量子比特时，会出现将逻辑态驱动到名义可纠错空间之外的耗散通道。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、三次元回路量子電磁力学系において、スペクトル的に設計された環境ノイズが弱非線形ボソンモードの光子損失をFock状態依存にし、非マルコフ的過渡ダイナミクスを生じさせるとともに、二項符号化された論理量子ビットに狭帯域ノイズを印加すると論理状態を名目上の訂正可能誤り空間の外へ駆動する散逸チャネルが現れることを実験的に示した。

title: Quantum Imaging of Nonlinear Magnetization Reversal and Dissipative Domain Dynamics
abstract: To investigate the rich nonlinear dynamics of magnetic materials, we introduce a stroboscopic quantum diamond microscopy technique to probe the dynamic AC response of a Pt/Co/Pt thin film using nitrogen-vacancy centres in diamond. By overcoming the limited dynamic range of conventional optically detected magnetic resonance based imaging, our approach enables the observation of magnetization reversal under various large-amplitude sinusoidal and square wave excitations. The observed phase delay between the applied field and the sample response reveals information about the energy dissipated within the material. The temporal evolution reveals magnetization reversal through domain nucleation and growth also demonstrating isolated bubble domains associated with the defects. Furthermore, the detection of higher order harmonics provides access to the nonlinear AC susceptibility. These results establish stroboscopic quantum diamond microscope as a promising tool for spatially and temporally resolving nonlinear magnetization dynamics, with potential applications extending beyond ferromagnetic systems to complex magnetic crystals, magnetic phase transitions and superconductor vortex dynamics.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a stroboscopic quantum diamond microscopy technique using nitrogen-vacancy centres to spatially and temporally resolve nonlinear magnetization reversal, dissipative domain dynamics, and higher-order AC susceptibility in a Pt/Co/Pt thin film under large-amplitude excitations.
summaries.zh: 该论文引入了一种基于氮-空位色心的频闪量子金刚石显微技术，可在空间和时间上分辨Pt/Co/Pt薄膜在大振幅激励下的非线性磁化反转、耗散畴动力学以及高阶交流磁化率。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、窒素空孔中心を用いたストロボスコピック量子ダイヤモンド顕微鏡法を導入し、大振幅励起下のPt/Co/Pt薄膜における非線形磁化反転、散逸的ドメイン動力学、および高次交流磁化率を空間的・時間的に分解して観測できることを示した。

title: Floquet dark-mode manipulation in a three-mode optomechanical system
abstract: We propose a Floquet sideband method to manipulate the dark-mode effect in a three-mode optomechanical system consisting of a single cavity mode coupled to two mechanical modes. We introduce a periodic frequency modulation for one mechanical mode to generate the Floquet sidebands, one of which is selected to match the resonance frequency of the other mechanical mode, allowing complete destructive interference to produce a mechanical dark mode decoupled from the cavity mode. The semiclassical operating point is determined self-consistently within the framework for linearization of optomechanical interaction, and the linear stability is examined under the rotating-wave approximation. We evaluate the validity of the approximate Hamiltonian by examining the fidelity between the states governed by the approximate and exact Hamiltonians. We further demonstrate dark-mode control by inspecting the bright/dark-mode populations of the system, when a frequency detuning is introduced suddenly. These results may provide a basis for further study of quantum-state storage using the Floquet mechanical dark modes.

summaries.en: This paper proposes a Floquet sideband method that uses periodic frequency modulation of one mechanical mode in a three-mode optomechanical system to create a mechanical dark mode decoupled from the cavity via complete destructive interference, with self-consistent semiclassical linearization, rotating-wave-approximation stability analysis, Hamiltonian fidelity checks, and detuning-based bright/dark-mode population control.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种Floquet边带方法，通过在由单腔模与两个机械模组成的三模光机械系统中对一个机械模施加周期性频率调制来产生Floquet边带，并选取其中与另一机械模共振频率匹配的边带以实现完全相消干涉，从而形成与腔模解耦的机械暗模，同时自洽确定半经典工作点、在旋转波近似下分析线性稳定性、通过哈密顿量保真度检验近似有效性，并借助频率失谐下的明暗模布居演示暗模调控。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、単一キャビティモードと二つの機械モードからなる三モード光機械系において、一方の機械モードに周期的な周波数変調を加えてFloquetサイドバンドを生成し、他方の機械モードの共鳴周波数に一致するサイドバンドを選ぶことで完全な破壊的干渉を生じさせ、キャビティモードから切り離された機械的ダークモードを実現するFloquetサイドバンド法を提案し、半古典的動作点の自己無撞着な決定、回転波近似下での線形安定性の検討、近似ハミルトニアンと厳密ハミルトニアンに支配される状態間のフィデリティによる近似の妥当性評価、および周波数離調導入時の明/暗モード占有の解析によるダークモード制御の実証を行う。

title: Noise-Immune Attractors in Stochastically Driven Non-Hermitian Systems
abstract: Temporal stochastic fluctuations generically destroy quantum coherence and accelerate defect generation in driven quantum systems. Here, we demonstrate that non-Hermitian dynamics can fundamentally reverse this trend by stabilizing noise-resilient late-time states. By developing an exact noise master equation for non-Hermitian systems subject to Gaussian fluctuations, we uncover a projective noise-invariance mechanism governed by T-symmetry-broken Liouvillian attractors. This mechanism produces robust defect-density plateaus and yields an exact geometric classification into noise-independent, fully polarized, and continuously tunable regimes. We substantiate these results in an imbalanced-pairing non-Hermitian Kitaev model, a prototypical pseudo-Hermitian system, and propose their experimental observation in coupled photonic waveguides. Our findings identify non-Hermitian attractor dynamics as a versatile route to controlling noise-induced excitations beyond conventional anti-Kibble-Zurek scaling.

summaries.en: By deriving an exact noise master equation for non-Hermitian systems under Gaussian fluctuations, the authors show that T-symmetry-broken Liouvillian attractors produce projective noise-invariant late-time states with robust defect-density plateaus in an imbalanced-pairing non-Hermitian Kitaev model, with a proposed realization in coupled photonic waveguides.
summaries.zh: 作者为非厄米系统在高斯涨落下的噪声建立了精确的主方程，证明破缺T对称性的Liouvillian吸引子会产生投影式噪声不变的晚期状态，并在失衡配对的非厄米Kitaev模型中给出稳健的缺陷密度平台，同时提出在耦合光子波导中实现。
summaries.ja: 著者らはガウス揺らぎを受ける非エルミート系に対する厳密なノイズマスター方程式を導出し、T対称性の破れたリウビリアンアトラクターが射影的なノイズ不変の遅延状態とロバストな欠陥密度プラトーを生み出すことを非バランス pairing の非エルミート Kitaev 模型で示し、結合フォトニック導波路での実験的観測を提案している。

title: Real-Time 250-kHz Spectral-Domain Optical Coherence Tomography Using a Jetson AGX Orin
abstract: High-performance optical coherence tomography (OCT) relies on desktop workstations for data acquisition, reconstruction, and visualization, limiting integration into compact imaging systems. We evaluated whether an embedded GPU platform could sustain real-time operation of a 250-kHz spectral-domain OCT instrument without a desktop computer. A custom C++/CUDA OCT engine running on a NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 64 GB was developed and integrated with a 2048-pixel spectrometer, Camera Link frame grabber, and galvanometer scanner, and compared against an RTX A4500 workstation under the same scan protocols. Both systems maintained mean B-scan processing latency well below the corresponding B-scan acquisition intervals. Although the RTX A4500 workstation achieved lower reconstruction latency, Jetson eliminated explicit host-to-device transfer and exhibited more consistent processing latency. Furthermore, the measured active wall power was 67 W for the Jetson and 155 W for the workstation, corresponding to approximately 2.3 times greater wall-energy efficiency for the Jetson. In a separate 62.6-min GUI-enabled measurement, the Jetson processed 800,000 B-scans without frame loss while maintaining real-time reconstruction and visualization. These results demonstrate that embedded computing can support high-speed OCT acquisition, processing, and control while reducing wall-power demand and computing-platform size.

title: A General Non-Stationary Channel Model for Autonomous Vehicle Communications in Underground Spaces
abstract: Autonomous vehicles exhibit high mobility and environmental adaptability, making them well-suited for underground inspection and rescue missions. In this paper, a general three-dimensional (3D) non-stationary geometry-based stochastic model (GBSM) is proposed for autonomous vehicle communications in underground spaces. The proposed channel model accounts for the 3D mobility of autonomous vehicles and can be adapted to pillar, tunnel, and cave scenarios. To characterize the structural and physical features of underground spaces, the proposed model incorporates the generation and evolution of spatially dispersed and/or directionally confined clusters along with their constituent specular/dense multipath components (SMCs/DMCs). Additionally, the proposed channel model considers channel non-stationarity, waveguide effect, and near-field/far-field effects. Statistical properties, including space-time-frequency correlation functions (STF-CFs), delay/angular/Doppler power spectral densities (PSDs), root mean square (RMS) delay spread, and stationary interval, are derived and analyzed. The validity of the proposed channel model is substantiated through comparative analysis between measurement and simulation results.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a general three-dimensional non-stationary geometry-based stochastic channel model for autonomous vehicle communications in underground spaces that captures 3D mobility, spatially dispersed and directionally confined clusters with specular and dense multipath components, waveguide and near-field/far-field effects, and is adaptable to pillar, tunnel, and cave scenarios while being validated against measurements.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种面向地下空间自动驾驶车辆通信的通用三维非平稳几何随机信道模型，能够刻画三维移动性、空间分散和方向受限的簇及其镜面与密集多径分量、波导效应和近场/远场效应，可适应柱状、隧道和洞穴场景，并与测量结果进行了对比验证。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、地下空間における自動運転車両通信のための汎用三次元非定常幾何学ベース確率チャネルモデルを提案し、三次元移動性、空間分散・方向制限クラスタとその鏡面／密マルチパス成分、導波管効果、近傍界／遠方界効果を考慮して柱・トンネル・洞窟シナリオに対応し、測定結果との比較により妥当性を検証している。
